author: CeraMo89

title: Good but absurdly expensive
body:
Everyday is a good habit tracker — it has good widgets, a good streak concept that genuinely motivates me and is rather simplistic.

All this made it disappointing when I found out about this apps pricing. A subscription model for an app like this is completely unnecessary, 30€ a year for a good but very simple app is not fair. It gets even more ridiculous when you consider it costs 99€ to purchase this app for life.

If you don’t want to submit to the genuinely absurd pricing then you are limited to tracking only 3 habits. Which by the way makes many widgets appear broken as they tend to have a multiple of 4 rows. 

All in all I would recommend to stay clear from this app, not only because short of spending an absurd amount of money it falls very short of what potential it has, but also to avoid supporting horrible business practices like this.

Finally, it’s just an habit tracking app, it’s good but far from groundbreaking. There’s tons of better options out there.

title: Geweldige hulp
body: Zo handig in gebruik. Je vult in welke gewoontes je wilt aanhouden en de app volgt jou mee op met reminders. Ik heb zo mijn hele dagstructuur opgemaakt, met nieuwe gewoontes in. author: Bluwwer

title: So far so not sure
body: I really like the idea and the beautiful look of the app, but the quality and devil is in the details, and the app has some way to go. The first thing I notice is that when I am to make a password, they only ask me to enter it once and I cannot see what I have written. Let’s just hope that I wrote what I thought I did, for the next time I am to login. Then, when I click “+ make new habit”, everything is filled in with my previous habit. I think I am editing my old one, so I click Cancel and try again. The same thing 4-5 times before I finally try to wipe out (there is no x to remove all the previous text either), and enter a new goal specifics on every line. It turns out this was how it should be done. Very non-intuitive. Also, whenever I click to write on a new line, it doesn’t capitalize the First letter which is annoying when you are to look at the habit name every day so I have to go back and Write properly. The UI looks a bit messy with large links to some videos (with some weird names?), other links are small. Basically, I ended up purchasing this to try for a year because I like the concept and the Black Friday deal (which right now is 15 euro, or 1 euro a month as they say - because details are not important and they clearly live in a 15 month year!) but for the price they are charging for this app, I really think they should have a quality control and think more about their user interface. Just follow the standards you see in other apps and you will be well on your way. I hope my monitary contribution will help them become better. And I hope I will become a better self by using this app every day. Win win?
